decision.outcome: not-fixed: finding premise disproved, awaiting user direction
decision.rationale: The overlap requires MultiSelect's clear button to exist in the DOM. It never does. PrimeReact's MultiSelect declares children: undefined in defaultProps and renders props.children only as the panel list content (multiselect.esm.js:310, :361, :942), so the <button aria-label="Clear selected options"> passed as a child of <PrimeMultiselect> at src/components/form/MultiSelect/MultiSelect.tsx:411-419 is never mounted. Rendering the shared MultiSelect with display=chip and two selected values yields 0 button elements in the control. With no absolutely positioned clear control, the new wrapping classes cannot overlap one, and the recommended [&>button]:!top-2 / [&>button]:!translate-y-0 variants would be dead CSS. The right-gutter half of the recommendation is also unnecessary: .p-multiselect-label-container is overflow-hidden and the trigger is a shrink-0 flex sibling, so chips are bounded by the container rather than running under the trigger.
